name: Forsta Surveys (Decipher)
description: Let agents keep track of your Forsta (Decipher) surveys: find surveys and their field status, read completes and drop-outs, quotas, the questionnaire's datamap and field warnings, and your company's usage for a period. Read-only.
identity: A Decipher API key of a Research Hub user. It reaches the surveys that user can, with any limits set on the key, so create it under a user made for agents.

setup.title: Create an API key
setup.body: Create the key as a user who has access only to the projects agents should see. You can also limit the key to certain calls, networks and an expiry date. Keys work over https only.
click: In the Research Hub, open the User Links menu and select API access.
Select Create API key, set any restrictions you want, and copy the key.

setup.title: Find your server address
setup.body: Use the host name you sign in to the Research Hub at, such as yourcompany.decipherinc.com. The command below checks the key and address and changes nothing.
click: Copy the host name from your browser's address bar while signed in to the Research Hub.

fields.label: Server address
fields.help: The host name of your Research Hub, without https:// or a path.

capabilities.label: Read surveys
capabilities.description: Find surveys with their state and completes, and read one survey's completes and drop-outs, quotas, datamap (its questions and answer codes) and field warnings.
capabilities.note: Reaches every survey the key's user can. Read-only.

capabilities.label: Read usage
capabilities.description: Read your company's usage for a date range, the completes your bill is based on, by project and device type.

revoke: In the Research Hub, open the User Links menu, select API access and delete the key. Agents lose access to Decipher at once.

tools.name: decipher_list_surveys
tools.description: Find surveys as in the Research Hub, by text, #tag or user:email. Each has its path (selfserve/<directory>/<project>), state, launch date and completes so far.

query.description: A Research Hub search, e.g. brand tracker, #wave3 or user:ann@example.com

tools.name: decipher_get_survey
tools.description: Read one survey's Research Hub record. Surveys are named by the two parts after selfserve/ in their path.

directory.description: The part after selfserve/ in the survey's path, e.g. 53b

project.description: The last part of the survey's path, e.g. 180401

tools.name: decipher_get_completions
tools.description: Read a survey's field summary: clickthroughs, partials, terminates, over-quotas and qualified completes, optionally split, e.g. by list.

directory.description: The part after selfserve/ in the survey's path

project.description: The last part of the survey's path

split.description: Split the counts by this, e.g. list

tools.name: decipher_get_quotas
tools.description: Read a survey's quotas: each cell's limit, completes, pending and over-quota counts.

directory.description: The part after selfserve/ in the survey's path

project.description: The last part of the survey's path

tools.name: decipher_get_datamap
tools.description: Read a survey's datamap: its questions, variables and answer codes, for checking the questionnaire and the data.

directory.description: The part after selfserve/ in the survey's path

project.description: The last part of the survey's path

tools.name: decipher_get_warnings
tools.description: Read a survey's field warnings for a period: participants blocked, missing images or scripts, errors and quota misses.

directory.description: The part after selfserve/ in the survey's path

project.description: The last part of the survey's path

tools.name: decipher_get_usage
tools.description: Read your company's usage between two dates: completes by project and by device type. Yesterday's data is ready a day or two later.
